our_interpretation: Assess the early ChatGPT available during the six-week history described in the post, through January 14, 2023.

The ordinary reading concerns substantive intellectual assistance with scientific work, including work done under human guidance. It does not require autonomous discovery or eligibility for authorship.

Genuine ideas means scientifically meaningful research suggestions; thoughtful summaries require accurate synthesis; controlled designs require appropriate controls and treatment of confounding factors.
Later publications can establish earlier performance only when their relevant outputs can be dated to the target period.
criteria.support_condition: Dated outputs and substantive expert evaluations establish the claimed deficiencies across idea generation, controlled experimental design, and literature synthesis. Isolated failures alone do not establish categorical inability.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented contemporary example supplies a scientifically meaningful idea, a sound controlled experimental design, or an accurate substantive literature synthesis, with independent assessment establishing that contribution.
